summary: The team is juggling urgent email lockout fixes with a packed agenda of program promotion, website redesign, and high-stakes partnerships, while gearing up for major events like APEC and the WIL Forum.
summaryDetail: Right now, the most pressing issue is the Outlook account lockout that has disrupted the team; everyone must re-login and update passwords across all devices, and JSB needs to confirm the backend unlock. In parallel, the marketing strategy is shifting into high gear: Asia Start and Intelligent China are the top promotion priorities (with Berkeley as a possible third), and the team is finalizing conversion tracking and participant analysis to sharpen targeting. The Knowledge website redesign is moving forward with a refined editorial layout, menu categorization, and the integration of BCI/BSI indices, while the CKGSB Monthly gets a stronger banner and the WIL Forum design awaits final brand checks. Looking ahead, several high-value opportunities demand attention: the APEC event concept note must be shared with Shengjia this week, the Macrobond and LinkedIn calls need scheduling, and the Americas website feasibility study is underway. With the Collaboration Award submitted and Q4 invoice payments to update, the team is balancing immediate fixes with strategic initiatives that will define CKGSB’s global visibility.
